notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.12:
- Another attempt at the rotation/squeeze bug after leaving the live player -- now re-applies the fix again shortly after exit to beat a timing race, since it was reported happening specifically on exit.
- Added a favorite (heart) button inside the live player itself.
- Fixed sort choice on Live/Movies/Series resetting every time you leave and return to the tab.
- Series now defaults to "Recently Updated" instead of Name A-Z (Movies already defaulted to Recently Added).
- Note: some channels with no sound is a known iOS limitation (AVPlayer can't decode AC-3/Dolby Digital audio) -- not something we can fix in the app.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
